text: This S1000D data module documents a title page for front matter content. It is issue 8, dated December 31, 2016, classified as new and unverified. Created by the Aerospace and Defence Industries Association of Europe, it applies to all systems. The module serves as introductory material for technical documentation.

This S1000D technical documentation module provides an overview of the S1000D specification itself—an international standard for technical publication procurement and production. It details S1000D's purpose, scope across aerospace, defense, and other industries, and comprehensive background on its development from the 1980s through international collaboration among ASD, AIA, and ATA organizations.

This S1000D technical documentation module provides guidance on tailoring S1000D documentation for specific projects, focusing on conformance and compliance requirements. Issued in December 2016 by the Aerospace and Defence Industries Association of Europe, this chapter (1.4.2) applies to all systems and offers instructions for adapting documentation standards to project-specific needs while maintaining regulatory compliance.

This S1000D data module is a table of contents or index for Chapter 3 of the FOSSIG (Fossil Fuel System Integration Guide) documentation, listing subordinate chapters with their titles and corresponding data module reference codes. It serves as a navigational guide to related technical documentation sections.

This S1000D data module documents FOSSIG business rule decisions for Chapter 2.1. It is a new, unverified technical document issued January 9, 2019, in English (Canadian). The content indicates that detailed business rule decisions will be provided in a future issue; currently, the module serves as a placeholder for forthcoming specification material.

This is a Publication Module (PM) document that serves as a master table of contents and organizational guide for S1000D Free Open Source Software Interest Group (FOSSIG) technical documentation. Issued January 9, 2019, it structures the publication into front matter (title page, abbreviations, introduction) and three main chapters covering FOSSIG introduction, business rules, and the Standard Numbering System (SNS), with references to detailed data modules for each section.
